此浏览器不支持全屏，请使用沉浸模式: Fullscreen is unavailable in this browser. Use immersive mode instead.
地球：拖动旋转，滚轮缩放，方向键旋转，空格播放或暂停: Earth: drag or use arrow keys to rotate, scroll to zoom, press Space to play or pause
地球影像加载失败，请刷新重试: Earth imagery could not load. Refresh to try again.
拖动地球旋转视角，滚轮或双指缩放。点击选择地点，双击或双点聚焦。: Drag the globe to rotate. Scroll or pinch to zoom. Click or tap to select a place; double-click or double-tap to focus.
拖动时间轴，观察昼夜交替。切换到一年和太阳视角，观察公转与地轴倾角。: Scrub the timeline to see day and night change. Select Year and Sun view to explore the orbit and axial tilt.
方向键旋转，空格播放或暂停，Esc 关闭面板。: Use arrow keys to rotate, Space to play or pause, and Esc to close a panel.
拖动地球，观察昼夜: Drag Earth to explore day and night
移动相机靠近月球，天体大小与距离比例保持不变。: Camera moved toward the Moon; body sizes and distances retain the same scale.
两球大小与距离同比例；轨道线为前后约半个月的月球路径。: Sizes and distance share one scale. The line traces about half a month before and after this date.
天体与距离同比例；近景仅移动相机。: Sizes and distances share one scale. Close-ups only move the camera.
云图与城市灯光并非实时天气。太阳和地月视角的天体大小与距离均使用同一真实比例；全: Clouds and city lights are not live weather. Both solar and lunar views use one physical scale; Earth may be smaller than a pixel in the overview. Labels mark positions only.
交互地球仪：经纬度、昼夜与四季: Interactive Earth: coordinates, daylight and seasons
一颗地球，许多看世界的方式。: One Earth. Many ways to see it.
拖动观察，点击大陆选择地点。时间停下时，仍然可以转动视角。: Drag to look around. Tap land to select a place. You can turn the view while time is paused.
怎样用两个角度，找到地球上的一个点？: How do two angles locate a place on Earth?
此刻，谁正在迎来日出？: Where is the Sun rising right now?
推进一天。晨线是由夜入昼的边界，昏线是由昼入夜的边界。: Advance a day. The dawn boundary leads into daylight; the dusk boundary leads into night.
同一天，南北半球的白昼一样长吗？: Do both hemispheres get the same daylight?
回归线与极圈，为什么在这些纬度？: Why are the tropics and polar circles here?
太阳越高，影子会怎样变化？: What happens to a shadow as the Sun rises?
选一处地面，推进一天。下方侧视图跟随当地太阳高度，假设地面水平、杆高一米。: Choose a place and advance a day. The side view follows the local Sun above level ground and a one-metre pole.
同一个瞬间，为什么各地的时间不同？: Why do clocks disagree at the same instant?
比较两地的太阳时和钟表时间。每向东15°，地方太阳时约早一小时；法定时区由地区规: Compare solar time and clocks. Every 15° east adds about an hour of solar time; civil time zones follow regional rules.
北极的一整天: A day near the North Pole
请先返回地球视角再保存课堂场景: Return to Earth view to save a classroom scene.
场景链接已复制，打开后从暂停状态继续: Scene link copied. It opens with time paused.
无法复制链接，请检查浏览器剪贴板权限: Could not copy. Check clipboard permissions.
纬度是地点与赤道平面的夹角；经度是经线平面与本初子午线平面的夹角: Latitude is the angle above the equatorial plane. Longitude is the angle between a meridian plane and the prime meridian plane.
所选纬线的昼弧和夜弧: Day and night arcs on your parallel
一米竖杆的影子侧视示意: Side view of a one-metre pole and its shadow
长影超出画幅时截断显示；数值保留真实比例。: Long shadows extend beyond the view; the reading gives their full length.
昼弧按几何晨昏线计算；日出日落含大气折射与太阳视圆面近似。太阳高度不含折射。: Day arcs use the geometric terminator. Rise/set times approximate refraction and the solar disk; altitude excludes refraction.
此地点钟表按经度估算时区。: This clock uses an estimated longitude-based time zone.
纬度从赤道量起，经度从本初子午线量起。金色纬线与蓝色经线在所选地点相交。: Latitude starts at the equator; longitude at the prime meridian. Gold and blue lines meet at your selected place.
地轴倾斜约23.44°。拖动一年，看两半球的昼弧如何此长彼短；地轴在一年内几乎指: Earth’s axis tilts about 23.44°. Scrub a year to compare daylight arcs. The axis keeps nearly the same direction in space.
地轴倾角对应23.44°回归线；90°减去倾角得到66.56°极圈。点击地球比较: The 23.44° tilt sets the tropics. Subtract it from 90° to get the 66.56° polar circles. Tap Earth to compare zones.
五带按太阳照射条件划分，不是实际气候类型或温度地图。: Latitude zones describe sunlight conditions, not actual climates or temperatures.
地图配色仅区分海陆: Map colours distinguish land and ocean only
